description: Tweak Factory registry: .deb tweaks the scheduled factory may collect from their official upstream, inject into an operator-supplied decrypted base app, and publish as provenance-tagged OmniSource releases. Hand-reviewed like catalog.json; the pipeline never writes this file (the operator's `tweak_factory.py build` helper may, on request). A build only runs when its base app (baseApps) is configured — the factory never pulls base IPAs from public decrypted-app stores (blocked by data/source_policy.json).

youtube.description: Decrypted YouTube base app shared by every YouTube tweak injection. Configure ONE of the three sources before enabling builds: (1) 'release' — your own private/public dumps repo where each release tag starts with tagPrefix and holds the decrypted .ipa; (2) 'variable' — a repository variable named envVar holding a direct https URL; (3) 'url' — a fixed https URL. The repo below is the recommended layout and does not exist yet: create it and push your dumps, or repoint the source.
